description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Broodhatch Nantuko, adding {C}{C}.
When Broodhatch Nantuko dies, Yedora triggers, returning Broodhatch Nantuko from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Broodhatch Nantuko by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Broodhatch Nantuko's morph ability by paying {2}{G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
